Frequently asked questions

Which maxi dress is good for a New Year party?

A georgette fit-and-flare gown or a V-neck A-line maxi with puff sleeves looks elegant at parties. The LITZO and Shasmi dresses on this page are made as party outfits.

What is an indo-western maxi dress?

It mixes an Indian ethnic look with a western gown cut, usually an A-line flared one-piece. The KZULLY dress on this page is an indo-western style.

Where can I buy maxi dresses online in India?

Through the Amazon.in links on this page. Size, price and returns are shown on the Amazon product page.
